menu.title: SPACEPLUG
menu.tagline: Cook. Mix. Smuggle. Pay the Consortium.
menu.help:
You start on Mireth with a debt to the Ouroboros Consortium.
Buy Cannabis Buds and additives, cook product in your lab, sell to contacts across the sector.
Every deal raises heat. Heat brings patrols – stay out of their scan circles while carrying product.
pause.title: Paused
settings.title: Settings
settings.window.tip: Play in a window or fullscreen.
settings.window_size.tip: Window size in windowed mode. The game scales to any size.
settings.vsync.tip: Sync frames to the monitor: no tearing, slightly more input delay.
settings.tutorial.tip: New games start with Okka's tutorial quests. Off = straight to the main quest.
settings.ui_scale.tip: Makes all text, the HUD, the phone and every panel bigger.
settings.shake.tip: How hard the camera shakes on hits, explosions and busts. Left = off.
settings.damage_numbers.tip: Show floating damage numbers over ships, officers and you.
settings.language.tip: Language of the menus. Other screens are translated step by step.
settings.display_hint: The game scales to any window size; the size only matters in windowed mode.
settings.key.tip: Click, then press the new key for "%s". Esc cancels.
settings.press_key_note: Press the new key for "%s". Esc cancels.
